rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something is included or forms part of a whole.

example.english: This set meal will include a drink and dessert.
example.traditional: 呢個套餐包括飲品同甜品。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 tou3 caan1 baau1 kut3 jam2 ban2 tung4 tim4 ban2

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice when emphasizing that an item comes bundled or is included as well.

example.english: This deal will include a mouse as well.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jau1 wai6 baau1 maai4 go3 waat6 syu2

rows.note: Use this when adding another item into a group, list, package, or total.

example.english: The list will include your name too.
example.jyutping: zoeng1 cing1 daan1 gaa1 maai4 nei5 go3 meng2

rows.note: Use this specifically when the included item is being counted in a calculation or total.

example.english: Please include this coffee in the bill too.
example.traditional: 唔該呢杯咖啡都計埋落張單度。
example.jyutping: m4 goi1 ni1 bui1 gaa3 fe1 dou1 gai3 maai4 lok6 zoeng1 daan1 dou6
